question: Who among the following broke the men's 20 km race walk world record at the Japanese Championships in Kobe in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Toshikazu Yamanishi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Toshikazu Yamanishi** broke the **men’s 20 km race walk world record** at the **Japanese Championships held in Kobe** in **February 2025**.
 
• He is a renowned **Japanese race walker**, known for his exceptional athletic performances in long-distance walking events.
 
• The event held in Kobe was a significant platform for race walkers, and Toshikazu's achievement marked a historic moment in the sport. *Hence, the correct answer is Toshikazu Yamanishi.*
 
• **Race walking** requires athletes to maintain contact with the ground at all times and ensure that their leading leg is straight from the moment of ground contact.
 
• Toshikazu Yamanishi has consistently demonstrated his mastery of this technique, which contributed to his record-breaking performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Toshikazu Yamanishi:**

 
 
• **Toshikazu Yamanishi** is a celebrated athlete from **Japan**, specializing in **race walking events**. Born in **1996**, he has represented Japan in multiple international competitions.
 
• He has previously won **gold medals** in the **IAAF World Athletics Championships** for the men’s 20 km race walk, showcasing his dominance in the sport.
 
 
 
• **Other Options:**
 
 
• **Koki Ikeda:** Another prominent Japanese race walker who has achieved significant success in international events. He won a **silver medal** at the **Tokyo Olympics 2020** in the 20 km race walk.
 
• **Eiki Takahashi:** A skilled race walker from Japan who has consistently performed at a high level but did not break the world record at Kobe in February 2025.
 
• **Yusuke Suzuki:** A famous race walker who set the previous **world record** in the 20 km race walk in **2015**. Although highly accomplished, he did not break the record in 2025.
 
 
 
• **20 km Race Walk:**
 
 
• The 20 km race walk is a long-distance athletic event in which competitors must adhere to specific rules of walking, ensuring one foot is in contact with the ground at all times.
 
• It is an Olympic event requiring immense stamina, technique, and discipline.
 
• Prominent athletes like **Yusuke Suzuki**, **Toshikazu Yamanishi**, and **Koki Ikeda** have brought global attention to the sport.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Race Walk Technique:**

 
 
• Athletes must keep **one foot in contact with the ground** at all times. The leading leg must remain **straight** from the moment of ground contact.
 
• This technique is closely monitored by judges, and any violation can lead to disqualification.
 
 
 
• **Historical Achievements:**
 
 
• **Yusuke Suzuki’s world record:** Set in **2015**, he completed the 20 km race walk in **1:16:36**, which was a benchmark in the sport.
 
• **Toshikazu Yamanishi:** Breaking this record in **2025** is a testament to his dedication and skill.
